domains.name: Monitoring, Logging, Analysis, Remediation, and Performance Optimization

tasks.name: Implement metrics, alarms, and filters by using AWS monitoring and logging services.
Identify and remediate issues by using monitoring and availability metrics.
Implement performance optimization strategies for compute, storage, and database resources.

concepts.name: Amazon CloudWatch
concepts.description: AWS observability service for metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, and related operational signals.

concepts.name: CloudWatch metrics
concepts.description: Numeric time-series data used to observe resource and application behavior.

concepts.name: CloudWatch Logs
concepts.description: Timestamped log events organized into log groups and log streams.

concepts.name: CloudWatch agent
concepts.description: Agent that can collect additional host or application metrics and logs and send them to CloudWatch.

concepts.name: CloudWatch alarms
concepts.description: Rules that evaluate metrics, expressions, or supported queries and change state when conditions are met.

concepts.name: CloudWatch composite alarms
concepts.description: Alarms that combine the states of other alarms with Boolean logic to reduce alert noise.

concepts.name: CloudWatch Logs metric filters
concepts.description: Filters that turn matching log events into CloudWatch metric data.

concepts.name: CloudWatch metric math
concepts.description: Expressions that calculate new time series from one or more CloudWatch metrics.

concepts.name: CloudWatch dashboards
concepts.description: Customizable views of metrics, alarms, and operational data, including cross-Region and cross-account views when configured.

concepts.name: Alarm actions and notifications
concepts.description: Actions or notification paths invoked when an alarm enters an actionable state.

concepts.name: AWS CloudTrail
concepts.description: Service that records AWS API and account activity for auditing and operational history.

concepts.name: Amazon EventBridge
concepts.description: Event routing service that matches events and sends them to targets.

concepts.name: EventBridge rules
concepts.description: Event-pattern rules that select events from a bus and route matching events to targets.

concepts.name: EventBridge input transformation
concepts.description: Transformation of matched event data into the payload shape expected by a target.

concepts.name: EventBridge retry and dead-letter handling
concepts.description: Delivery controls for retrying failed target invocations and retaining undelivered events in a DLQ.

concepts.name: EventBridge archive and replay
concepts.description: Capability to retain selected events and replay them through an event bus later.

concepts.name: Amazon SNS
concepts.description: Publish/subscribe messaging service used to fan notifications out to subscribers.

concepts.name: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus
concepts.description: Managed Prometheus-compatible monitoring service for containerized and other Prometheus-instrumented workloads.

concepts.name: Systems Manager Automation
concepts.description: Systems Manager capability for running multi-step operational runbooks against AWS resources.

concepts.name: Automation runbooks
concepts.description: Documents that define parameters, ordered steps, actions, and outputs for Systems Manager Automation.

concepts.name: Automation targets and rate controls
concepts.description: Target selection plus concurrency and error controls that limit the blast radius of Automation runs.

concepts.name: Systems Manager Run Command
concepts.description: Capability for remotely running commands on managed nodes without interactive login.

concepts.name: AWS Lambda remediation
concepts.description: Event-driven code used for custom operational remediation and integration logic.

concepts.name: AWS DevOps Agent
concepts.description: AI-powered operations service that correlates application topology, telemetry, code, and deployment context during investigations.

concepts.name: Operational signals and responses
concepts.description: Distinguishing metrics, detailed event or log records, and downstream actions or notifications.

concepts.name: AWS Compute Optimizer
concepts.description: Service that analyzes utilization data and produces performance and cost optimization recommendations.

concepts.name: EC2 performance optimization
concepts.description: Right-sizing and monitoring compute, storage, and network limits that affect EC2 workload performance.

concepts.name: EC2 placement groups
concepts.description: Cluster, partition, and spread placement strategies for workload latency, throughput, and fault-isolation requirements.

concepts.name: Amazon EBS performance
concepts.description: IOPS, throughput, latency, queueing, burst behavior, and instance-to-EBS bandwidth that affect block-storage performance.

concepts.name: EBS volume types
concepts.description: SSD and HDD EBS volume families chosen according to IOPS, throughput, latency, and cost requirements.

concepts.name: Amazon S3 performance
concepts.description: Concurrency, request parallelism, transfer methods, and access patterns used to optimize S3 workloads.

concepts.name: S3 multipart upload
concepts.description: Uploading a large object as independent parts that can be transferred in parallel and retried independently.

concepts.name: S3 Transfer Acceleration
concepts.description: Accelerated long-distance transfer path that uses AWS edge locations and the AWS global network.

concepts.name: S3 Lifecycle
concepts.description: Rules that transition or expire objects according to age and other criteria.

concepts.name: AWS DataSync
concepts.description: Managed service for moving and synchronizing data between supported on-premises and AWS storage locations.

concepts.name: Amazon EFS performance
concepts.description: EFS performance and throughput modes, concurrency, and CloudWatch metrics used to optimize file-system workloads.

concepts.name: EFS lifecycle management
concepts.description: Policies that move files between EFS storage classes according to access patterns.

concepts.name: Amazon FSx
concepts.description: Managed file systems for workloads that need specialized file-system protocols or capabilities.

concepts.name: Amazon S3 Files
concepts.description: Shared file-system interface over S3 data with file semantics, active-set acceleration, and automatic synchronization.

concepts.name: Amazon RDS monitoring
concepts.description: CloudWatch and RDS operational metrics used to detect database resource pressure.

concepts.name: RDS Performance Insights
concepts.description: Database performance analysis focused on DB load, waits, and SQL dimensions.

concepts.name: Amazon RDS Proxy
concepts.description: Managed database proxy that pools and reuses database connections to improve connection scalability and resilience.

concepts.name: Amazon RDS recommendations
concepts.description: Automated and proactive recommendations derived from configuration, usage, and performance analysis.

concepts.name: Kiro
concepts.description: AI-powered development environment and agent surfaces that can assist with infrastructure-as-code and AWS troubleshooting workflows.

concepts.name: EC2 networking performance
concepts.description: EC2 instance networking capabilities, enhanced networking, EFA, and placement choices that affect throughput and latency.

concepts.name: AWS resource tags
concepts.description: Key-value metadata used to organize, scope, filter, and operate on groups of AWS resources.
